##### Project general facts

Binghatti Ghost by Binghatti is a residential tower defined by a bold architectural identity, clean lines and crystalline glass facades that create a sleek, sculptural presence. Windows open onto views of the creek, the city and the surrounding greenery. The tower rises above two basement levels, a ground floor with retail units and podium levels with parking to twenty residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool, a well-equipped gym and a spa for everyday wellness, along with a children's play area and a jogging lane for active families. Landscaped green areas, event lawns, walking paths and relaxation and recreation zones create calm places to unwind, while retail outlets add everyday convenience, complemented by family- and pet-friendly policies, a welcoming lobby, lifts, covered parking and round-the-clock security.

Apartments feature practical layouts and high-quality interior finishes, with large windows that fill the living spaces with natural light. Efficient floor plans suit young professionals, couples and families seeking a central address close to the main business districts. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens only, leaving furniture and appliances beyond the kitchen to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf is a culturally rich waterfront district along Dubai Creek, combining heritage, commerce and leisure. The Dubai Culture Village, the Al Jaddaf Waterfront promenade, luxury hotels such as Palazzo Versace and a growing choice of restaurants, cafes and parks give the area a calm, characterful atmosphere, with panoramic views across the creek towards the historic heart of the city and the modern skyline.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Al Jaddaf and Creek metro stations are close by. Wafi Mall and Dubai Healthcare City are a short drive away, Dubai Festival City and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary are close by, and Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Al Jaddaf is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most central waterfront addresses in Dubai. Proximity to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Creek views, metro access and competitive prices compared with neighbouring prime areas underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
